action_summary: Make the instant-learning claim falsifiable, then falsify what it overstated. canonical/tools/instant_learning_seeded_store_ablation_v1.py is the producer that five_named_commits_20261124_v1.json never had: three store arms (cold, general seeded from one disjoint exposure, raw), F2P/P2P grading taken from the reference patch rather than from whole-file green, per-task nop/oracle controls decided in advance, resolution graded by a fresh pytest that imports the mutated work tree, and every unmeasurable task named instead of counted. It reproduces click@05f6fd0df (resolved with an empty store, model_calls 0, five times over), and does NOT reproduce werkzeug@051fd6635, which the receipt records as solved: 2 of 5 becomes 1 of 4 measured. canonical/tools/one_or_two_witness_generalization_probe_v1.py then localizes the cause in 0.9 s with three numbers -- lifted arities 10/1/0, 0 of 6 cross-commit applications fire, 0 of 3 witness pairs anti-unify on an arity equality precondition -- which is why this branch files zero capability credit and instead deletes a belief: that more exposures would generalize. Restored the three egress-enforcement tests lost to an environment rewind, sized the true-capability CI budget from a measured 734 s rather than a 15-minute habit, and reconciled 42 quoted claims about this repo (33 modules present, 9 real on main, LOC within 1-59, 756 open PRs and #7144's 22/22 exact, typed_invention's depth-3 and 80k verified verbatim, metamorphic_laws is a law checker not a reverse synthesizer, Agent S4 and BiSpace verified with BiSpace's parameter write stated).
